tasks.label: git: auto commit & push
args: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $branch = (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null); if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($branch)) { $branch = 'main' }; git add -A; if (git diff --cached --quiet) { Write-Output 'No changes to commit'; exit 0 }; $msg = 'auto: ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'); git commit -m $msg; try { git pull --rebase origin $branch } catch {}; git push origin HEAD:$branch

tasks.label: git: pull --rebase (manual)
args: $branch = (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null); if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($branch)) { $branch = 'main' }; git pull --rebase origin $branch
